responsibility: Implements out-of-line construction, copy/assignment, and helper behavior for concrete Rust HIR expression nodes. This file owns the runtime support code for many expression classes declared in `rust-hir-expr.h`, including operator expressions, literals, block expressions, loops, async blocks, inline assembly operands, anonymous constants, and related metadata wrappers, chiefly by cloning nested HIR subtrees, preserving `NodeMapping` and source locations, and initializing expression payloads used after AST lowering.
same_name_distinction: Provides the out-of-line implementations for the expression classes declared in `rust-hir-expr.h`: constructors, copy/assignment, deep-cloning, and helper bodies for concrete HIR expression nodes such as operators, loops, async blocks, anonymous constants, and inline assembly operands. Unlike the header, it does not define the expression hierarchy or interfaces.
